reviewItem.question: Does "Removal of wildcard permissions: prior versions contained wildcard view permissions, which allowed Kyverno controllers to view all resources including secrets…" mean a change to rbac-permission:kyverno|name=* (removed)?

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13 removes the wildcard view permission that previously allowed Kyverno controllers to view all resources (including secrets) and replaces it with a role binding to the default `view` role, which will not impact policies during admission controls but may impact reports and users with mutate or generate policies on custom resources the controller may no longer be able to view.
